Subject: Rain Plan for May 4 Seed Swap

Hi folks,

With heavy rain in the forecast, we are moving the May 4 seed swap indoors to the market hall. Everything else stays the same, including tables for labeling and trading. Please bring one seed packet from your stash to share, and come dry off with fellow growers.

Subject: Keeping our spring swap dry this weekend

Wet weather is in the forecast, so we are moving the seed swap indoors to the market on May 4. You will find our tables set up inside out of the rain, ready for trading heirloom varieties and garden staples. Remember to bring one packet to join the exchange.
